---
pagetitle: "CV"
lang: en
params:
  pdf_mode:
    value: true
output:
  pagedown::html_paged:
    css: ['dd_cv.css']
    self_contained: true
    toc: false
    number_sections: false
---

```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  results = 'asis',
  echo = FALSE
)

library(magrittr) # For the pipe
source("cv_printing_functions.r")

# Read in all data and initialize a CV printer object
CV <- create_CV_object(
  data_location = "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ZvBze1Di0TIXBg3PieaCr5iR1vaI6u7RNdeLE9yVcdo",
  pdf_mode = params$pdf_mode
)
```

```{r}
# Header: `title` and `subtitle` rows of the `text_blocks` sheet + links from `contact_info`
CV %>% print_europass_header()
```

```{r}
# "intro" row of the `text_blocks` sheet
CV %<>% print_europass_text("intro", heading = "About me")
```

```{r}
# Sections of the `entries` sheet (the `section` column decides where a row goes)
CV %<>% print_europass_section("experience",     heading = "Work experience")
CV %<>% print_europass_section("education",      heading = "Education and training")
```

```{r}
# `language_skills` sheet (language, CEFR level)
CV %>% print_europass_languages()
```

```{r}
# `it_skills` sheet (skill, level)
CV %>% print_europass_skills()
```

```{r}
CV %<>% print_europass_section("publications",   heading = "Publications")
CV %<>% print_europass_section("conferences",    heading = "Conferences and training delivered")
CV %<>% print_europass_section("certifications", heading = "Courses and certifications")
```

```{r}
# PDF only: numbered list of the links shown as superscripts above
CV %>% print_europass_links()
```
